meta.title: Report Access Policy
meta.subtitle: Who may view, share and export clinic operations reports
meta.audience: Report owners, facility administrators and regional operations leaders
meta.purpose: Set one rule for granting, reviewing and removing access to clinic operations reports
sources: Synthetic example content for the document-builder skill; replace with the request, attachments and the sources the user names

blocks.text: This policy sets one rule for who may view, share and export clinic operations reports, so patient-level numbers reach only the people who need them for their work.
This policy covers every clinic operations report published on the analytics portal, including saved views and scheduled exports.

items: It applies to report owners, facility administrators and regional operations leaders.
It doesn't cover finance or payroll reports, which follow their own access rules.

blocks.text: Access follows the minimum a role needs. A manager approves each request, and the report owner reviews every access list each quarter.

items: Request access through the portal; email requests aren't accepted.
Share reports by link only; don't attach exports to email.
Remove access within five business days when a role changes.

blocks.text: Exports that contain patient-level rows stay on approved network drives. Don't save them to personal devices.

blocks.caption: Who does what under this policy
rows: Approves the access list for each report and reviews it every quarter
Approves or declines each access request within two business days
Uses reports only for their work and shares them by link

blocks.caption: Terms used in this policy
rows: The people and groups who can open a report
A row that describes one patient rather than a total
The report owner's check that every person on the list still needs access

blocks.text: The report owner may approve an exception for up to 90 days. Record the reason, the end date and the approver on the access request.
